drafts.en:
Health Functional FoodNiacin 9mgBiotin 15μgVitamin A 450μgVitamin B6 0.9mgVitamin C 50mgVitamin D 5μgVitamin E 7mgSelenium 35μgZinc 5mgOnce a day

듀오락 비타 면역 꾸미Niacin · Biotin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Selenium · Zinc

Made by (주)에스디푸드 · Once a day · 3 gummys

This product combines 9mg of Niacin, 15μg of Biotin, 450μg of Vitamin A, 0.9mg of Vitamin B6, 50mg of Vitamin C, 5μg of Vitamin D, 7mg of Vitamin E, 35μg of Selenium, 5mg of Zinc as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (3 gummys): 9mg Niacin, 15μg Biotin, 450μg Vitamin A, 0.9mg Vitamin B6, 50mg Vitamin C, 5μg Vitamin D, 7mg Vitamin E, 35μg Selenium, 5mg Zinc
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)에스디푸드

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day3 gummys per servingChew to take

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (9mg / 9g), 80~150%
Biotin labelled (15μg / 9g), 80~180%
Vitamin A labelled (450μg / 9g), 80~150%
Vitamin B6 labelled (0.9mg / 9g), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (50mg / 9g), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (5μg / 9g), 80~180%
Vitamin E labelled (7mg / 9g), 80~150%
Selenium labelled (35μg / 9g), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (5mg / 9g), 80~150%
Appearance 이미, 이취가 없고 고유한 향미가 있는 빨강색의 곰 모양 젤리
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 18개월까지
Storage 1. 실온 2. 제품이 고온에 약하니 직사광선을 피하여 30 ℃ 이하의 온도, 습도가 낮은 곳에 보관하십시오. 3. 제품 개봉 후에는 밀봉하여 보관하시고 가급적 빨리 섭취하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Biotin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Selenium · Zinc together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Keep out of reach of children · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
